name: Information Technology University (ITU), Lahore
_note: Weights from ITU 'Norms & Criteria' (updated 2026-08-12), Selection Criteria. Only BS Computer Science / BS Artificial Intelligence give the Matric vs Inter split; other BS programs give one 'Academic Record' weight (EE/SE/CE 50 + test 50; M&T/FinTech 40 + 60; Economics with Data Science 50 + 50) without saying how it is formed, so no formula is stored for them. No closing merit published.

formulas.label: BS Computer Science / BS Artificial Intelligence (with HSSC or HSSC Part-I)
formulas.source_note: Applicants with HSSC (Part 1)/HSSC: Academic Record 50% (Matric/O-Level 15% + Inter part I/Inter/A-Level 35%) + Admission Test/SAT-I/USAT 50%. Minimum 50% in the ITU Admissions Test.
